action_items: Update /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 3 tests (test_compatibility_real_ai, test_compatibility_persisted, test_send_voice_message) need either (a) demo1 promoted to premium for that test class, or (b) assert 402 since these are now premium-gated. They are stale, not failing app behavior.
Consider splitting /app/backend/server.py (1514 lines) into modules (safety.py, support.py, ai.py, payments.py, websocket.py) — file is now >700 line maintainability threshold.

Nominatim geocoding call is synchronous inside PUT /api/profile — a slow/timeout from Nominatim will block the request. Consider running it as a background task or adding a tight timeout (current httpx default).
/api/safety/panic accepts match_id as query param only (FastAPI shorthand) but expected as body in some test scenarios. The empty-body POST works because the param is Optional. OK for now.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 1514 lines violates 700-line guideline — split into routers.

ensure_admin_premium runs on EVERY authenticated request (Depends(get_current_user) -> ensure_admin_premium). For admin accounts the conditional update is idempotent but for non-admins it still hits the function — cheap but consider short-circuiting with the early-return.
geocode_city uses Nominatim live; on rate limit / outage profile update silently degrades (no error, just no coords stored) — acceptable per spec but should log a warning.

Blocked-user filtering in /api/profiles/discover: confirmed working. But the reverse direction (user A appears in discover for user B who blocked A) should also be excluded — only verified one direction in this test run. Recommend explicit test.

/api/matches/{id}/extend uses match.get('expires_at') but accepts None when absent — uses datetime.now as base — fine. However max(current_expiry, now) for an already-passed match resets to now+3 days; intended behavior, but worth documenting.
POST /api/safety/block sets match.status='blocked' but /api/matches/{id}/agree-date and /extend don't check status; a blocked match could still be agreed/extended. Add status guard.
/api/ai/date-planner only checks match membership but not match.status; a blocked or unmatched conversation could still call AI date planner. Add status='matched' guard.
